target_claim: $$\binom{n}{2b+1}\left( \frac{2}{cn\cdot 2^f}\right)^{2b}= \frac{n^{2b+1}}{(2b+1)^{2b+1}} \frac{(2b+1)^{2b+1}}{2^f\cdot cn} = \frac{n}{1}\cdot\frac{1}{4^{f}\cdot n}=\frac{1}{4f}$$ Note that $n^{2b+1}=n^{2b}\cdot n = 2n = n$
